content: Di la Shawulu yoti kantni tikanka kerek tayek kange twalangka nob bwangka Yesu chere ni wabe durkonen.
Kentencho bifumer naci yaciko kuwabe kwamamu Dimaskus, wori no fiya ni nanure woceri Bwayile kange nawiye, naci bou kici wursalima naci bwamci.
kambo liyakentiyeri chin dadom kange Dimaskus dang jang, dang jang filango yirau di kwama kangtangumcho.
lachin yarken bitineri cin nuwa diro kange yichoti “Shawulu, Shawulu yebwi mu neye dotange tiye?
Shawulu ciyi toki kii we mwo kwama?” kwama yicho “mo Yesu wuro mune dotange tiyeu.”
Di la kweni doken mor cinar lorcho ciyam yinen dikerowa tamyo maneu.
Nubowo yakenti kange shawulu tirangum bir-bir cin lem diker tok kar, chi nuwa dirti, dila citobo nii wii.
Shawulu kweni bitine kambo chi wom nuwe ceri, mani ci toh dikerti, lacin tacinen kango cinbouki cho mor cinar lor Dimaskus.
lam kume taar manici toti manici cati, manici noti.
Nii tomange kange wi Dimaskus dencero Hannaniya, dila kwama tok ker kange cho mor dukumer yicho ki “Hannaniya” ciki To, minwo kwama”
Kwama yicho, Kweni yaken cinarloro choti ki Mikakke, lo niwo choti ki Yahuza me ni bou Tarsus dencero Shawulu, ci kwob diloti.
Chinto mo dukume nikange douti dendo Hannaniya wi douti dila kun kang yocinenti wori nuweceu na wumom.
Di la Hannaniya ciya kwama min nuwa fulen nubowin ducce dor niwon kange dara bwiram nanye net cero cima nubo lomwennen wucakeu yim wursalima.
Liya wabe durko necho nyal naci tam gwamm nubowo chodencerotiyeu.”
Dila kwama yicho ya cho cin kulen nangenner minr min chokum cho choke wo awaden miroti nubo nenneu kange liyabtinib kange Israila.
Wori man dancinen dotange ca nuwati ker denerer miu.”
la Hannaniya yaken doken luwecho. yocinenti kanko dor, yiki “kemi shawulu Yesu toki wo dandorcer munen nure kikwama mu boutiyeu, toh muye nati fiya toka fiyek nadimki yuwa tangbeko wucakeu.
dang jang dikero kange no wulom dikem nuwe shawulu, la fiyam toka fiyek kwene cin yucinen mwem kwamambo.
La chamcharito cho ci necho bikwam neret yi wari kange nob bwangkab wi Dimaskus kumeni kila.
Wi danjang neker Yesurti mor kuwabe yitki incho bibkwe kwama.
kwarub nubo nuwa cho tiyeu cin yimangti ciki “wo kebo niwo twalang nubo wursalimatiya choden do wotiyeu ba? ciboufota natamci cineken liya wabe durko.”
Di la shawulu fiyam bikwan kambo ken ci bouti ki kwamka kange bolka tiber Yafudawar kange nubo yim Dimaskus ki nurewo ci dancimen Yesu incho Kristi.
Ki kumeni kila nawo chumeu, Yafudawa mwer kangi nacin twallum cho.
Di la Nyomom dike mwertiyeu. Cii chirou choti nyilo kalek cinar lorocho nacin twallum cho.
Di la ki cin kumeri nob bwankabo tuh cho mor bulene chin dokken cho tiyak.
Kambo chi bou wursalimari, shawulu cwinaci mwerkandor kange nob bwangkab. Di la kwarub ce ci cwachoti wori ci ciyabo chokeneu cin yilam nii bwangkaba.
La Barnabas tuh cho bouchiko nob tomangebo nen. yici kambo Shawulu wabkan kange kwama nureu. Di la kwama tok kero kange cho, shawulu ma tok ker Yesu nyang lang Dimaskus.
Wabkanci kwama dotacek kange cerkacek wursalima. In tok ker kwamar nyanglang mor den Yesu.
Chin ma kwobkanke kange Yafudawa Helenawa, dila cinti naci to chi twallumcho.
Kambo kebbebo nyimom nyeri, cho ci beken kicho Kaisariya. ci tunkencho Tarsus.
Lana nyime Ekilisiya gwam biten Yafudiya. Galili kange Samariya ci fiya luma kange muka lachi yi yim cimbo ti mor tai kwama, kange birim nerem Yuwatangbe kwamak, nob kwamabo kila chiko chob ten.
Yilam kambo Bitrus buyelangum chunka bitinen kocho gwam, yilam nob bwanka kwamake yim biten Lydda.
Cin fiya nii kange dendo Aeneas, wur bwiyo nom nowe, dim choro narub dor kwangnid.
Birtus yicoki Aeneas, Yesu kiristi twamnen. kweni kun diker damer mwero. nawonyo kweninti.
La gwamm nubo biten Lydda kange biten sarona cinto niiwo, dila cin yilau fiye kwama wiyeu.
Naweu ni kwama kange wi yafe dendo tabita, dendo Kinug “Dorcas” Nawiye wo dimki mana nangen do ken cii bwini nubo manki dikereti.
In lam kwama wo ci daken twira la cin buyam, kambo ci Yuchinen mwembo ci yokencho luwe diyeu.
Dila Lydda bidom kange yafa nob bwanka be nuwa Bitrus kinon firen cin twom nubo yob cinen. Cii kenchoti, “Tabre bwi bou nyinen”.
Bitrus kweni yaken kange ci, danjang ci bouri, cho ci yaken kicho luwe diye. La natub bunebo bouti ti bidom chiwiyeti, la chin tuh belendo kange kulendo Dorcas churcineneu ki kwama ciwariyeu.
Bitrus cho kumai gwamm mor kuwe, chunken kwob dilo, dila yila chunya twarek, kii, “Tabita kwenuu”. ci wom nuweceu, cito Bitrus ri chin yiken.
Bitrus tar kanceko kunnyu cho lana nyime chou bwanka kwamako kange natub bunebo, cin neci Tabita ki dume.
Dikerowo yilam nubo nyimom gwamm yafa, la nyori nubo ducce ne bilenke kwama nen.
La yilam Bitrus yi kumeni kila kange Yafa kange ni kange dendo saminu Majemi
